## Project Overview
- **Project Name:** Supreme Villagio
- **Master Developer:** Supreme Universal (40+ Years Legacy, 75+ Delivered Projects across Mumbai & Pune)
- **Official Status:** Authorised Project Marketing & Information Portal
- **Location:** Somatane, Pune, Maharashtra 410506, India
- **Geographical Elevation:** 616 Meters Altitude (Cool hill-station microclimate, misty mountain horizons)
- **Masterplan Scale:** 16 Acres Low-Rise Gated Sanctuary (65% Dedicated Open Green Landscape by Site Concepts International, Singapore)
- **Typologies:** 4 BHK Premium Townhouses, 4 BHK Luxury Twin Villas, 5 BHK Grand Presidential Hillside Villas

## Verified MahaRERA Registrations & Handover Status
- **Phase I:** MahaRERA Reg `P52100046867` — Status: **100% Completed, Occupation Certificate (OC) Received, Handed Over**
- **Phase II:** MahaRERA Reg `P52100049506` — Status: **100% Completed, Occupation Certificate (OC) Received, Handed Over**
- **Phase III:** MahaRERA Reg `P52100055048` — Status: **Under Active Construction (New Launch), Statutory Completion: December 31, 2028**
- **Official MahaRERA Portal:** https://maharera.mahaonline.gov.in/

## Transparent Pricing & Inventory Matrix (2026)
- **4 BHK Premium Townhouse:** Carpet Area 2,200 – 2,400 Sq. Ft. | G+2 Layout | Starting from **₹2.89 Cr***
- **4 BHK Luxury Twin Villa:** Carpet Area 2,600 – 2,900 Sq. Ft. | 3-Side Open Private Lawn | Starting from **₹3.45 Cr***
- **5 BHK Grand Presidential Villa:** Carpet Area 3,400 – 3,900 Sq. Ft. | Private Elevator & 3 Car Bays | Starting from **₹4.85 Cr***

## Clubhouse & Amenities
- **Club Villagio:** Ready 18,500 Sq. Ft. Grand Clubhouse
- **Key Features:** Olympic-length swimming pool, badminton & squash courts, wellness gymnasium, banquet halls, yoga pavilion, landscaped central wellness spine.
